span.p:
members
id PK
email UNIQUE, lower-cased
display_name, password_hash
is_operator, plan_active
created_at

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
spaces
id PK
name, capacity
hourly_rate_satang BIGINT
archived_at

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
bookings
id PK, reference UNIQUE BK-...
member_id FK, space_id FK
start_time, end_time, blocks
party_size, note
agreed_price_satang BIGINT, coverage
status, hold_expires_at
payment_session_id, payment_outcome
(JSON payment_status)
cancel_reason, refund_reason
refund_amount_satang, refund_status, refund_attempt
grant_status, grant_id, ticket_url
EXCLUDE overlap WHERE status held or confirmed

div.style: color: rgb(11, 27, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:
test_clock
one row, now or null

payment_sessions
id PK ps_...
booking_reference UNIQUE
amount_satang BIGINT, currency THB
description, success_url, cancel_url
expires_at, status, payment_status

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:

session_id FK
card_brand, card_last4
outcome, decline_code, created_at

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 400px; text-align: center;

span.p:

amount_satang BIGINT, reason
attempt, status
UNIQUE (payment_session_id, attempt)
